| ffx_fsr1.h | 93c3922362ea7fc99cbcc698ca30c98de4f8c246d1fbb0b09e015ddef38ce3a5 |

Used by `dm/linux/vk/shaders/upscale_fsr_easu.comp` and `upscale_fsr_rcas.comp`
(`DM_UPSCALER=fsr1`). To refresh, download both files at a new commit, check
them in unmodified, and update this table.
